lane:
سمدع

سميدع سَمَيْدَعٌ , (S, K, &c.,) of the measure فَعَيْلَلٌ, (Sb, TA,) so accord. to the grammarians, but Aboo-Usámeh Junádeh El-Azdee says that it is of the measure فَمَيْعَلٌ, from سَدْعٌ as syn. with ذَبْحٌ and بَسْطٌ, (Sgh, TA,) pronounced by the vulgar سُمَيْدَع, with damm to the س, (IDrst, TA,) which is a mistake, (Th, IDrst, S, K, &c.,) for there is not in the language of the Arabs a noun of the measure فُعَيْلَلٌ, (IDrst, TA,) _A lord, master, chief, prince,_ or _man of rank or quality;_ ('Eyn, S, O, K;) to which Et-Teiyánee adds, from As, on the authority of Munteji' Ibn-Nebhán, (TA,) _of easy nature_ or _disposition, generous, and very hospitable,_ or _in whose vicinity his companion has power_ or _authority_ or _dignity, not being harmed nor inconvenienced;_ (S, K, TA;) and thus expl. by AHát also; (TA;) _generous; noble,_ or _elevated in rank; liberal, bountiful,_ or _munificent:_ (O, K:) and also (K) _courageous:_ (Lth, K:) and _goodly, and stout, bulky,_ or _corpulent:_ (AZ, EtTeiyánee:) pl. سَمَادِعُ. (IJ.) === The _lion._ (Ibn-Ed-Dahhán, T, S, O.) === And hence, [accord. to SM, but the reverse I think more probable,] ‡ _A chief,_ or _person of authority._ (TA.) === The _wolf;_ (En-Nadr, K;) because of his swiftness. (En-Nadr.) === And hence, (TA,) ‡ A man _active, agile,_ or _prompt, in accomplishing his wants._ (K, TA.) === And _A sword._ (K.)

classical.name: Kitab al-Ayn
classical.source: OpenITI Shamela0001682-ara1 (Makhzumi & Samarra'i, Dar wa-Maktabat al-Hilal)

entries.text: السَمَيْدَعُ بالفتح: السيِّدُ الموطّأ الأكنافِ، ولا تقل سُمَيْدَعٌ بضم السين.

سمدع: السَّمَيْدَعُ: بِالْفَتْحِ: الْكَرِيمُ السَّيِّدُ الْجَمِيلُ الْجَسِيمُ المُوَطَّأُ الأَكناف، والأَكنافُ النَّوَاحِي، وَقِيلَ: هُوَ الشُّجاعُ، وَلَا تَقُلِ السُّمَيْدَعُ، بِضَمِّ السِّينِ. وَالذِّئْبُ يُقَالُ لَهُ سَميْدَعٌ لِسُرْعَتِهِ، وَالرَّجُلُ السريعُ فِي حَوَائِجِهِ سَمَيْدَعٌ.
